propositions: Auto-bug filers (heartbeat, binding-drift, conflict) lack dedup keys, templates, and empty-detail aborts, causing duplicate filing and hollow tickets on gate changes.
Heartbeat filer must file bugs only after >=2 consecutive red runs using workflow run-history as state store, with max one accumulation comment per 24h to prevent spam.
Binding-drift filer files on first-observed drift with accumulation+dedup but no consecutive-red threshold since drift is persistent state and oracle never fails the run.
Conflict filer must use stable per-pair dedup tags (local-id + jira-key), templated body, abort-if-empty detail, and detected_by stamp without auto-close (conflicts require adjudication).
Bug-creation contract must document exact rebar create args, exit codes, dedup search commands, and detected_by env var so future filers produce well-formed tickets.

Audit table must enumerate all three auto-file sites with per-site row mapping which pattern elements apply and rationale (including kept auto-close divergence for heartbeat/binding-drift and no-threshold rationale for binding-drift).
